irregularities.finding: The template mask has 5,167,373 finite cells. In the owner-mirrored training raster, 3,061 of those cells carry the float32 nodata sentinel in each of 18 bands; band 6 (tc) has 12 additional sentinel cells (3,073 total). These counts were measured by reading the raw float32 band bytes and intersecting with the template footprint. The earlier 1,521-cell claim was incorrect because it compared whole-raster valid counts from grids with different masks.
irregularities.evidence: Reproducible per-band counts in evidence/input_grid_audit.json, generated by scripts/audit_inputs.py from the 17 hash-verified owner-mirror inputs.
irregularities.consequence: Any model writing raw nodata sentinels as probabilities can trigger the portal's [0,1] error. The reference TIFF is re-written from a source raster that already contains only 0/1/NaN and is validated on disk. This does not prove it will pass the organizer's portal.

irregularities.finding: The first-pass evaluation sampled pseudo-hidden truth pixels from the known catalogue and then called reconstruct_shadow(emission, hidden), which adds predictions at the sampled hidden truth locations whenever existing emission lies within the selected radius. The prediction therefore used held-out truth coordinates. The radius was swept against owner-reported live scores and then used as a scoring parameter.
irregularities.consequence: All first-pass DTI gains and '15/16 cells' statements are withdrawn. They are not a valid holdout or evidence for submission-slot promotion. Experimental TIFFs were removed from docs/downloads.

irregularities.finding: Seeds 0 and 1 used in the so-called confirmation were also used in exploratory pruning selection, and the 10% trim was selected after a 40k/35k/30k budget sweep. The number of fold x seed cells is not an independent sample count when spatial folds and tuning are reused.
irregularities.consequence: No first-pass confirmation result is treated as preregistered independent evidence.

irregularities.finding: The pseudo-truth was sampled from the catalogue, while H27/H36/H38 remove dots near the visible catalogue. irregularities.consequence: No cross-family ranking is reported. A valid comparison needs held-out whole fault systems, predictions generated without their geometry, a matched budget, and an independent source-label validation.
